title: Response of Hellinger-distance based coherence to weak decoherence in two-flavor neutrino oscillations
summary: We evaluate the Hellinger-distance coherence of the two-flavor neutrino state subject to Lindblad damping of the mass-eigenstate interference term, and obtain a closed expression in terms of the flavor-basis density-matrix elements. In the two-flavor vacuum treatment with negligible wave-packet separation, the undamped state is pure, and the smallest eigenvalue of the damped state grows linearly with $ε=1-κ$, where $κ=e^{-ΓL}$. An expansion about the pure state then yields a nonanalytic $\sqrtε$ correction to the Hellinger coherence, with coefficient $K=2\sqrt{2}\,u\sin2θ/\sqrt{1-2u}$,…
